source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 11 (PDF 234-257), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Human Circulatory System) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
11.1 Structure and functioning of the heart

blocks.prompt:
1 The closed blood circulatory system of humans consists of:
(Insanon ka band (closed) blood circulatory system kin cheezon par mushtamil hai?)

options.text: lymph, lymph nodes aur lymph vessels

blocks.explanation: Band blood circulatory system khoon, dil aur blood vessels (arteries, capillaries aur veins) par mushtamil hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: The closed blood circulatory system of humans consists of blood, heart

blocks.prompt:
2 In a healthy person, plasma makes up about what share of blood by volume?
(Sehatmand insan mein plasma khoon ke hajm (volume) ka taqreeban kitna hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Plasma khoon ke hajm ka taqreeban 55% aur cells ya cell jaise ajsam taqreeban 45% hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: plasma constitutes about 55% by volume of the blood

blocks.prompt:
3 The human heart is situated:
(Insani dil kahan waqe hai?)

options.text: seene ki cavity ke darmiyan, phephron ke beech
pait ki cavity ki baayen taraf

blocks.explanation: Dil seene ki cavity ke darmiyan phephron ke beech hai; is ki pusht reerh ki haddi ke qareeb aur saamne ka hissa sternum ke peeche hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It is situated in the middle of chest cavity (between the lungs).

blocks.prompt:
4 Because the heart lies between the lungs:
(Dil phephron ke darmiyan hone ki wajah se:)

options.text: daayan phephra chhota hai aur is mein cardiac notch hai
baayan phephra chhota hai aur is mein cardiac notch hai

blocks.explanation: Baayan phephra daayen se chhota hai aur is ke kinare mein dil ke liye cardiac notch hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: has a cardiac notch in its border to accommodate the heart

blocks.prompt:
5 The sac that encloses the heart and separates it from surrounding organs is the:
(Dil ko gherne wali aur use aas paas ke aaza se alag karne wali theli kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dil pericardium naam ki theli mein band hai jo use aas paas ke aaza se alag karti hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Heart is enclosed in a sac called pericardium

blocks.prompt:
6 The fibrous pericardium protects the heart against external pressure and shocks and also:
(Fibrous pericardium dil ko bahari dabao aur jhatkon se bachane ke ilawa kya karta hai?)

options.text: dil ki dharkan shuru karta hai
dil ko zarurat se zyada phailne se rokta hai
phephron ko khoon pump karta hai

blocks.explanation: Bahari fibrous pericardium mazboot connective tissue ka hai; yeh dil ki hifazat karta aur use zarurat se zyada phailne se rokta hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It also prevents excessive dilation of heart.

blocks.prompt:
7 The visceral pericardium, closely attached to the heart, is also called:
(Visceral pericardium jo dil se chipka hota hai, use aur kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Serous pericardium ki bahari teh parietal aur andaruni teh visceral hai, jise epicardium bhi kehte hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Inner visceral pericardium (also called epicardium)

blocks.prompt:
8 The pericardial cavity between parietal and visceral pericardium contains:
(Parietal aur visceral pericardium ke darmiyan pericardial cavity mein kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pericardial cavity mein 50 mL tak pericardial fluid hota hai jo dil ko chikna rakhta aur infections se bachata hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It contains up to 50 mL pericardial fluid.

blocks.prompt:
9 The thickest layer of the heart wall, made of cardiac muscles, is the:
(Dil ki deewar ki sab se moti teh jo cardiac muscles ki bani hai, kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Epicardium ke neeche myocardium hai, sab se moti teh, jo cardiac muscles ki bani hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: the thickest layer of heart wall i.e., myocardium

blocks.prompt:
10 The endocardium is:
(Endocardium kya hai?)

options.text: dil ki deewar ki bahari tah
dil ke chambers ki andaruni tah banane wali epithelial cells ki aik teh

blocks.explanation: Endocardium myocardium ke neeche hai; yeh epithelial cells ki aik teh hai jo dil ke chambers ki andaruni tah banati hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It is a single layer of epithelial cells and make the inner linings

blocks.prompt:
11 The two upper, thin-walled chambers of the heart are the:
(Dil ke do upar wale patli deewar ke chambers kaunse hain?)
blocks.explanation: Dil mein upar do patli deewar wale atria hain jo khoon lete hain aur neeche do moti deewar wale ventricles jo khoon aage bhejte hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: two upper thin-walled atria and two lower thick-walled ventricles

blocks.prompt:
12 The septum that separates the left and right ventricles and is much thicker than the interatrial septum is the:
(Woh septum jo daayen aur baayen ventricle ko alag karta hai aur interatrial septum se bohat mota hai, kaunsa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Interventricular septum ventricles ko alag karta hai aur interatrial septum se bohat mota hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It is much thicker than the interatrial septum.

blocks.prompt:
13 The mitral valve is another name for the:
(Mitral valve kis valve ka doosra naam hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bicuspid (mitral) valve do cusps ka hai aur baayen atrium aur baayen ventricle ke darmiyan hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Bicuspid (mitral) valve (made of two cusps)

blocks.prompt:
14 The valves at the exit points of the ventricles, shaped like a half-moon, are the:
(Ventricles ke nikalne ki jaghon par aadhe chaand jaisi shakal ke valves kaunse hain?)
blocks.explanation: Do semilunar valves (pulmonary aur aortic) ventricles ke nikalne ki jaghon par hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: At the exit points of ventricles, there are two semilunar valves

blocks.prompt:
15 The pulmonary and aortic valves close when:
(Pulmonary aur aortic valves kab band hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ventricles dheele hone par pulmonary aur aortic valves band ho kar pulmonary artery aur aorta se ventricles mein khoon wapas aane se rokte hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: When ventricles relax, pulmonary and aortic valves close.

blocks.prompt:
16 The tricuspid and bicuspid valves are located in the:
(Tricuspid aur bicuspid valves kahan waqe hain?)

options.text: atrioventricular septum mein, ventricles ke dakhli raston par

blocks.explanation: Do atrioventricular valves ventricles ke dakhli raston par atrioventricular septum mein hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: At the entrance points of ventricles (in atrioventricular septum)

blocks.prompt:
17 The human heart is called a double pump because it:
(Insani dil ko double pump kyun kehte hain?)

options.text: is ke pericardium ki do tehein hain
har cardiac cycle mein do baar dharakta hai
pulmonary aur systemic dono circulations chalata hai
khoon aur lymph dono pump karta hai

blocks.explanation: Dil pulmonary circulation (phephron tak) aur systemic circulation (phephron ke siwa tamam aaza tak) dono chalata hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Human heart functions as a double pump.

blocks.prompt:
18 The right atrium receives deoxygenated blood from the body through the:
(Daayan atrium jism se oxygen ke baghair (deoxygenated) khoon kin ke zariye leta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Deoxygenated khoon superior aur inferior vena cava ke zariye daayen atrium mein aata hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: via two veins i.e., superior vena cava and inferior vena cava

blocks.prompt:
19 The pulmonary trunk divides into:
(Pulmonary trunk kis mein taqseem hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary trunk baayen aur daayen pulmonary arteries mein batt'ta hai jo deoxygenated khoon phephron tak le jati hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: The pulmonary trunk divides into left and right pulmonary arteries

blocks.prompt:
20 Oxygenated blood from the lungs is brought to the left atrium by the:
(Phephron se oxygen wala khoon baayen atrium tak kaun lata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary veins phephron se oxygen wala khoon baayen atrium mein lati hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: The oxygenated blood from lungs is brought to left atrium by pulmonary veins.

blocks.prompt:
21 The wall of the left ventricle is about how many times thicker than that of the right ventricle?
(Baayen ventricle ki deewar daayen ventricle se taqreeban kitne guna moti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baayen ventricle ki deewar taqreeban 3 guna moti hai kyun ke use khoon poore jism mein dhakelna hota hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: thicker (about 3 times) than that of the right ventricle

blocks.prompt:
22 The relaxed period of the heart chambers, when the atria fill with blood, is called:
(Dil ke chambers ki dheeli muddat jab atria khoon se bharte hain, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Jab atria aur ventricles dono dheele hon aur atria khoon se bharen to yeh muddat diastole hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: This relaxed period of heart chambers is called diastole.

blocks.prompt:
23 Ventricular systole pumps blood into the:
(Ventricular systole khoon ko kahan pump karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Bhare hue ventricles ke sukarne (ventricular systole) par khoon pulmonary arteries aur aorta mein jata hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: This is called ventricular systole and it pumps the blood

blocks.prompt:
24 In one complete heartbeat, diastole lasts about:
(Aik mukammal dharkan mein diastole taqreeban kitni der rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Diastole taqreeban 0.4 second, atrial systole 0.1 second aur ventricular systole 0.3 second ka hota hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: diastole lasts about 0.4 sec

blocks.prompt:
25 In one complete heartbeat, ventricular systole lasts about:
(Aik mukammal dharkan mein ventricular systole taqreeban kitni der rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ventricular systole taqreeban 0.3 second; atrial systole 0.1 second; diastole 0.4 second (11.1).

book_ref.quote: the ventricular systole lasts about 0.3 sec

blocks.prompt:
26 In one's life, the heart beats about:
(Aik insan ki zindagi mein dil taqreeban kitni baar dharakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Zindagi bhar dil bina ruke taqreeban 2.5 billion baar dharakta hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: heart beats about 2.5 billion times

blocks.prompt:
27 The 'dubb' sound of the heartbeat is produced when:
(Dil ki dharkan ki 'dubb' awaz kab paida hoti hai?)

options.text: tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band hote hain
ventricles dheele hone par pulmonary aur aortic semilunar valves band hote hain

blocks.explanation: Ventricular systole khatam ho kar ventricles dheele hone par semilunar valves band hote hain aur 'dubb' awaz aati hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: the pulmonary and aortic semilunar valves close and

blocks.prompt:
28 The 'lubb-dubb' sounds of the heart can be heard with a:
(Dil ki 'lubb-dubb' awazein kis aale se suni ja sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lubb-dubb stethoscope ki madad se suni ja sakti hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: can be heard with the help of a stethoscope

blocks.prompt:
29 A heart murmur is heard when:
(Heart murmur kab sunai deta hai?)

options.text: neend mein dil ki raftar kam ho
valves poore band na hon ya tang khulen aur turbulence paida ho

blocks.explanation: Agar valves poore band na hon ya tang khulen to dil mein turbulence (hal chal) paida hoti hai jo murmur ki shakal mein suni jati hai, jaise sar sar ki awaz (11.1).

book_ref.quote: turbulence is created within the heart

blocks.prompt:
30 Serious heart murmurs can be corrected by:
(Sanjeeda heart murmurs ko kaise theek kiya ja sakta hai?)

options.text: kharab valves ko masnooi ya donor ke valves se badal kar

blocks.explanation: Zyada tar murmurs sanjeeda nahi; sanjeeda murmurs kharab valves ko masnooi ya donor ke valves se badal kar theek kiye jate hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: replacing the damaged valves with artificial ones

blocks.prompt:
31 The sinoatrial (SA) node consists of:
(Sinoatrial (SA) node kis cheez ka bana hai?)

options.text: dimagh se aane wale nerve fibres ka bundle
cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha

blocks.explanation: SA node (pacemaker) cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha hai jo daayen atrium ki upari deewar mein hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: The sinoatrial node consists of a small cluster of cardiac muscle cells.

blocks.prompt:
32 The atrioventricular (AV) node lies at the:
(Atrioventricular (AV) node kahan waqe hai?)
blocks.explanation: AV node bhi cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha hai aur interatrial septum ke nichle hisse mein hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It lies at the lower portion of interatrial septum.

blocks.prompt:
33 The atrioventricular bundle (bundle of His) is a network of fibres present in the:
(Atrioventricular bundle (bundle of His) fibres ka jaal hai jo kahan hai?)
blocks.explanation: AV node se impulses bundle of His tak pohanchte hain jo interventricular septum mein fibres ka jaal hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It is a network of fibres present in interventricular septum.

blocks.prompt:
34 The left and right branches of the AV bundle end at the:
(AV bundle ki baayen aur daayen shakhein kahan khatam hoti hain?)

options.text: ventricles ki deewaron ke Purkinje fibres

blocks.explanation: AV bundle ki shakhein Purkinje fibres par khatam hoti hain; in ke ubharne se ventricles taqreeban aik saath sukarte hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: which end at the Purkinje fibres in the walls of the ventricles

blocks.prompt:
35 The delay of about 0.15 second in conduction of impulses from the SA node to the AV node:
(SA node se AV node tak impulse pohanchne mein taqreeban 0.15 second ki takheer ka kya faida hai?)

options.text: atria aur ventricles ko aik saath sukarati hai
atrial systole ko ventricular systole se pehle mukammal hone deti hai

blocks.explanation: 0.15 second ki takheer se atrial systole ventricular systole shuru hone se pehle mukammal ho jata hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: There is a delay of about 0.15 second

blocks.prompt:
36 An artificial pacemaker is used in patients whose:
(Masnooi (artificial) pacemaker kin mareezon mein lagaya jata hai?)

options.text: jin ka SA node kamzor ho
jin ki coronary arteries band hon
jin ke lymph nodes soojhe hon

blocks.explanation: Kamzor SA node wale mareezon mein battery se chalne wala masnooi pacemaker electrical signals de kar normal dharkan chalata hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: In such patients of weak SA node, artificial pacemaker is used.

blocks.prompt:
37 The heart of an average adult beats about:
(Aik aam baligh insan ka dil taqreeban kitni baar dharakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam baligh ka dil taqreeban 70 baar fi minute dharakta hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: The heart of an average adult beats about 70 times per minute.

blocks.prompt:
38 During fever and exercise, the heart rate increases because:
(Bukhar aur warzish mein dil ki raftar kyun barhti hai?)

options.text: dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node ko nerve signals bhejta hai
daayan atrium ANH kharij karta hai

blocks.explanation: Bukhar aur warzish mein dimagh ka control centre pacemaker aur AV node ko signal de kar raftar barhata hai; aaraam mein kam karta hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: during fever and exercise, the control centre in brain sends nerve signals

blocks.prompt:
39 In an adult, every day about 8,000 litres of blood move through:
(Baligh insan mein roz taqreeban 8,000 litre khoon kitne lambe blood vessels se guzarta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roz taqreeban 8,000 litre khoon 96,000 km lambe blood vessels se guzarta hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: about 8,000 litres of blood move through 96,000 km

blocks.prompt:
40 An electrocardiogram (ECG) is a recording of:
(Electrocardiogram (ECG) kis cheez ki recording hai?)

options.text: cardiac impulses ke currents se banne wale electrical potentials

blocks.explanation: ECG cardiac impulses ke currents se banne wale electrical potentials ko skin par lage electrodes se record karta hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: is known as electrocardiogram (ECG)

blocks.prompt:
41 The machine that records the electrical potentials of the heart is the:
(Dil ke electrical potentials record karne wali machine kaunsi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Skin par lage electrodes electrocardiograph se jure hote hain jo potentials record karta hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: The electrodes are attached to a machine called electrocardiograph

blocks.prompt:
42 In an ECG, the P wave shows:
(ECG mein P wave kya dikhati hai?)
blocks.explanation: P wave atrial depolarization ki shuruat dikhati hai jo SA node shuru karta hai; is se atria sukarte hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It shows beginning of atrial depolarization, initiated by SA node.

blocks.prompt:
43 Irregular or absent P waves may indicate:
(Be-qaida ya ghayab P waves kis cheez ki nishani ho sakti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Be-qaida ya ghayab P waves arrhythmia (dharkan mein be-tarteebi) ki nishani ho sakti hain (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Irregular or absent P waves may indicate arrhythmia

blocks.prompt:
44 A first-degree heart block is shown in the ECG by:
(ECG mein first-degree heart block kaise zahir hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: normal PR interval 0.12-0.20 second hai; first-degree heart block mein PR interval 0.20 second se lamba hota hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: A first-degree heart block is a prolonged PR interval (more than 0.20 seconds).

blocks.prompt:
45 Atrial repolarization occurs during the ECG phase called:
(Atrial repolarization ECG ke kis phase mein hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: QRS ventricular depolarization ki shuruat dikhata hai; atrial repolarization bhi isi phase mein hoti hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Atrial re-polarization also occurs during this phase.

blocks.prompt:
46 The ST segment is elevated in:
(ST segment kis halat mein upar utha hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: ST segment ischemia mein neeche aur myocardial infarction mein upar hota hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It can be depressed in ischemia

blocks.prompt:
47 The ST segment of an ECG ordinarily lasts about:
(ECG ka ST segment aam tor par kitni der ka hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: ST segment ventricular depolarization ki takmeel dikhata hai aur taqreeban 0.08 second ka hota hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: This segment ordinarily lasts about 0.08 second.

blocks.prompt:
48 The T wave of an ECG represents:
(ECG ki T wave kya zahir karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: T wave ventricles ki repolarization ki shuruat hai; is ki kharabi electrolyte ki gharbar dikha sakti hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: It represents the beginning of repolarization of ventricles.

blocks.prompt:
49 A normal QT interval, from the beginning of QRS to the end of the T wave, is usually about:
(Normal QT interval (QRS ki shuruat se T wave ke aakhir tak) aam tor par kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Normal QT interval aam tor par taqreeban 0.40 second hota hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: A normal QT interval is usually about 0.40 seconds.

blocks.prompt:
50 Blue babies (cyanosis) can result from failure of the:
(Blue babies (cyanosis) kis cheez ke band na hone se ho sakte hain?)

options.text: interatrial foramen ka nashonuma ke dauran band na hona

blocks.explanation: Cyanosis tab hota hai jab interatrial foramen band na ho aur atria ke darmiyan oxygen wala aur baghair oxygen ka khoon mil jaye (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Cyanosis results due to the failure of interatrial foramen to close

blocks.prompt:
51 The ductus arteriosus is a temporary channel in the embryo between the:
(Ductus arteriosus embryo mein kin ke darmiyan aarzi raasta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ductus arteriosus embryo ki pulmonary artery aur aorta ko jorta hai; aam tor par yeh nashonuma mein band ho jata hai (11.1).

book_ref.quote: Ductus arteriosus is a temporary channel between the embryonic pulmonary artery and aorta.

blocks.prompt:
52 Which arteries carry deoxygenated blood?
(Kaunsi arteries deoxygenated khoon le jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary arteries ke siwa tamam arteries oxygen wala khoon le jati hain (11.2).

book_ref.quote: All arteries carry oxygenated blood, except pulmonary arteries.

blocks.prompt:
53 The outer layer of an artery wall is called:
(Artery ki deewar ki bahari teh kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Artery ki deewar: bahari tunica externa (adventitia) connective aur elastic tissue ki, darmiyani tunica media, andaruni tunica intima (11.2).

book_ref.quote: Outer layer i.e., tunica externa or adventitia

blocks.prompt:
54 The tunica media of an artery, made of thick muscular tissue and elastic fibres, helps the artery to:
(Artery ki tunica media (moti muscle aur elastic fibres) artery ko kis qabil banati hai?)

options.text: ventricular systole mein zyada blood pressure bardasht karna
valves se khoon wapas aane se rokna

blocks.explanation: Darmiyani teh ventricular systole ke dauran zyada blood pressure bardasht kar sakti hai (11.2).

book_ref.quote: Middle layer is important and it can withstand higher blood pressure

blocks.prompt:
55 The tunica intima of an artery is made of:
(Artery ki tunica intima kis cheez ki bani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Andaruni tunica intima endothelial cells ki patli teh hai (11.2).

book_ref.quote: Inner layer i.e., tunica intima is made of thin layer of endothelial cells.

blocks.prompt:
56 The walls of capillaries are made of:
(Capillaries ki deewarein kis cheez ki bani hain?)
blocks.explanation: Capillaries ki deewarein endothelial cells ki aik teh hain, is liye khoon aur tissues mein cheezon ka tabadla hota hai (11.2).

book_ref.quote: The walls of capillaries are made of a single layer of endothelial cells.

blocks.prompt:
57 The internal diameter of a capillary is about:
(Capillary ka andaruni diameter taqreeban kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Capillary taqreeban 8 micrometre chauri hai, itni tang ke RBCs aik qatar mein guzarte hain (11.2).

book_ref.quote: The internal diameter of a capillary is about 8 micrometres.

blocks.prompt:
58 No cell of the body is more than how far away from a capillary?
(Jism ka koi cell capillary se kitne fasle se zyada door nahi?)
blocks.explanation: Jism ka koi cell capillary se 100 micrometre se zyada door nahi (11.2).

book_ref.quote: No cell of the body is more than 100 micrometres away from a capillary.

blocks.prompt:
59 Capillaries are so narrow that:
(Capillaries itni tang hain ke:)

options.text: koi WBC kabhi bahar nahi nikal sakta
in mein khoon sab se tez behta hai
plasma in se nahi guzar sakta
RBCs ko aik qatar mein guzarna parta hai

blocks.explanation: Capillaries itni tang hain ke RBCs un mein se aik qatar mein guzarte hain (11.2).

book_ref.quote: RBCs must pass through them in single line

blocks.prompt:
60 The total length of capillaries in an adult human is estimated to be over:
(Baligh insan mein capillaries ki kul lambai ka andaza kitne se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baligh mein capillaries ki kul lambai 80,600 km se zyada hai, jo zameen ke gird do baar lipat sakti hai (11.2).

book_ref.quote: total length of capillaries in an adult human is over 80,600 kilometres

blocks.prompt:
61 When interstitial fluid leaks out of capillaries, which remain inside the capillaries?
(Jab interstitial fluid capillaries se rasta hai to kaunsi cheezein capillaries ke andar rehti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Interstitial fluid mein paani, ghiza, hormones, gases, fuzlaat aur chhote proteins hote hain; bare proteins, RBCs aur platelets capillaries mein rehte hain (11.2).

book_ref.quote: Large proteins, RBCs and platelets remain within capillaries.

blocks.prompt:
62 Some materials are taken up by capillary wall cells and passed to the other side by:
(Kuch cheezein capillary ki deewar ke cells kis tareeqe se le kar doosri taraf pohanchate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kuch cheezein endocytosis se capillary ki deewar ke cells mein ati hain aur exocytosis se doosri taraf jati hain (11.2).

book_ref.quote: Some materials are also taken up by capillary wall cells by endocytosis.

blocks.prompt:
63 Which veins carry oxygenated blood?
(Kaunsi veins oxygen wala khoon le jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary veins ke siwa tamam veins deoxygenated khoon le jati hain (11.2).

book_ref.quote: All veins carry deoxygenated blood, except pulmonary veins.

blocks.prompt:
64 An empty vein collapses like an empty balloon because:
(Khaali vein khaali ghubbare ki tarah kyun pichak jati hai?)

options.text: is ki tunica media moti hai
yeh cells ki aik teh ki bani hai
is ki tunica media patli aur thori si muscle wali hai

blocks.explanation: Vein ki darmiyani teh patli aur kam elastic fibres wali hai kyun ke veins ko zyada pressure nahi sehna parta; khaali artery khokhli rehti hai (11.2).

book_ref.quote: an empty vein collapses like an empty balloon

blocks.prompt:
65 Semilunar valves in veins:
(Veins mein semilunar valves kya karte hain?)

options.text: dil ki dharkan shuru karte hain
dil ki taraf jate khoon ko wapas behne se rokte hain
tissues se gases ka tabadla karte hain

blocks.explanation: Veins ke semilunar valves dil ki taraf jate khoon ko wapas behne se rokte hain (11.2).

book_ref.quote: Semilunar valves are present in veins to prevent the back flow of blood

blocks.prompt:
66 The return of blood in veins towards the heart is assisted by:

blocks.prompt:
67 Which chemical can dilate capillaries?

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:

circular muscles se zyada elastic tissue

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
73 The velocity of blood in the vena cavae is about:

book_ref.quote: veins and vena cavae (250-300 mm/sec)

blocks.prompt:
74 The changes in velocity of blood in different vessels result from changes in:

book_ref.quote: These changes in the velocity of blood result from changes in the total cross section

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
76 In pulmonary circulation, blood is oxygenated in the:
(Pulmonary circulation mein khoon kahan oxygen hasil karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulmonary arteries arterioles aur lung capillaries mein batt'ti hain jahan khoon oxygen hasil karta hai (11.2).

blocks.prompt:

blocks.explanation: Lung capillaries mil kar pulmonary venules aur veins banati hain jo baayen atrium mein khulti hain (11.2).

blocks.prompt:
78 The right and left coronary arteries arise from the:

blocks.prompt:
79 The coronary veins join to form the coronary sinus, which opens into the:

book_ref.quote: The coronary veins join to form a coronary sinus

blocks.prompt:
80 A portal system is a circulation in which:
(Portal system kis circulation ko kehte hain?)

capillaries arteries mein khatam hoti hain
lymph veins mein dakhil hota hai
veins capillaries par khatam hoti hain

blocks.prompt:
81 The hepatic portal vein collects blood from the:

blocks.prompt:
82 The hepatic portal system extends from the:

book_ref.quote: extends from the lower portion of oesophagus to the upper part of anal canal

blocks.prompt:
83 In renal circulation, each afferent arteriole divides to make the:

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
85 Which of these is NOT present in humans?
(In mein se kya insanon mein nahi hota?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: book ki figure par 'Renal portal system' likha hai, magar insanon mein renal portal system nahi hota; figure renal circulation dikhati hai (11.2).

blocks.prompt:
86 Blood pressure is the measure of:
(Blood pressure kis cheez ka paimana hai?)

fi minute pump hone wale khoon ka hajm

book_ref.quote: Blood pressure is the measure of force exerted by blood against the inner walls

blocks.prompt:
87 The term blood pressure most commonly refers to:
(Blood pressure ki istilah aam tor par kis ke liye istemal hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pressure poore vascular system mein hota hai magar blood pressure se aam tor par systemic arterial blood pressure muraad hai (11.3).

book_ref.quote: most commonly refers to systemic arterial blood pressure

blocks.prompt:
88 The rhythmical throbbing of arteries created by the flow of blood is called:

blocks.explanation: Arteries ki deewarein lachakdar hain, is liye khoon ke bahao se baqaida dhak dhak hoti hai jise pulse (nabz) kehte hain (11.3).

book_ref.quote: The flow of blood creates rhythmical throbbing of arteries

blocks.prompt:
89 Diastolic pressure in a normal young adult is:

blocks.explanation: Diastolic pressure, agle ventricular contraction se pehle arteries ka sab se kam pressure, aam jawan mein 75-85 mm Hg hai (11.3).

book_ref.quote: Diastolic pressure in a normal young adult is 75-85 mm Hg.

blocks.prompt:

book_ref.quote: The instrument sphygmomanometer is used for the manual measurement

blocks.prompt:
91 Baroreceptors (pressure receptors) are present in the:

blocks.explanation: Baroreceptors carotid arteries (sar aur dimagh ko khoon dene wali) aur aortic arch mein hote hain (11.3).

book_ref.quote: are present in carotid arteries

blocks.prompt:
92 When blood volume and pressure decrease, receptors in the brain stimulate the posterior pituitary to secrete:

blocks.explanation: Kam hajm aur pressure par dimagh ke receptors pyaas paida karte aur posterior pituitary se ADH kharij karwate hain (11.3).

book_ref.quote: stimulate posterior pituitary gland to secrete antidiuretic hormone (ADH)

blocks.prompt:
93 ADH raises blood volume and pressure by:
(ADH khoon ka hajm aur pressure kaise barhata hai?)

options.text: namak aur paani ka ikhraj tez kar ke
gurdon se zyada paani roak kar aur arterioles tang kar ke
dil ki raftar kam kar ke

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
95 ANH lowers blood volume and pressure by:

book_ref.quote: It speeds up the excretion of salts and water through urine

blocks.prompt:

118 Lymph capillaries, where the lymphatic system begins, have:

blocks.prompt:
119 Larger molecules can enter lymph capillaries because lymph capillaries:

options.text: in ka pressure arteries se zyada hai

blood capillaries se zyada permeable hain

blocks.prompt:

blocks.prompt:
